Statement generalized from the type-0 couple of def-sp-exact-couple to an exact couple of type s (g of bidegree (s,-s)), which the iteration needs: the derived couple of a type-0 couple has g' of bidegree (1,-1), so the induction for C_r runs over types r-2; for s=0 the statement is the old one. Claims stated as before (ker d, im d, well-definedness of alpha', f', g', exactness of the derived couple, D_r = im alpha^{r-2}, bidegrees). Proof written in 12 steps: element calculus with elements T -> X up to epimorphic refinement (Stacks 011T/08N5; Mathlib Refinements.lean, new Mathlib-leaf node lem-sp-abelian-refinements), d o d = 0, the two subobject identities, the three constructions by universal properties (epi = cokernel of its kernel, def-sp-abelian), the three exactness chases, assembly, and the induction on r. No Freyd-Mitchell; differences of elements are differences in Hom(T,X). Proof is agent-written (Stacks omits it). theorem pageCouple_image_prefix {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) :
    ∃ (A : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), X.D (p + n) (q - n) ⟶ X.D p q)
      (I : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (X.pageCouple n).D p q ⟶ X.D p q),
      (∀ p q : ℤ, A 0 p q = eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), A (n + 1) p q =
        X.alpha (p + (n + 1 : ℕ)) (q - (n + 1 : ℕ)) ≫
          eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega) ≫ A n p q) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, I 0 p q = 𝟙 (X.D p q)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), I (n + 1) p q =
        (X.pageCouple n).derivedDInclusion p q ≫ I n p q) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Mono (I n p q)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), imageSubobject (I n p q) = imageSubobject (A n p q)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
        (X.pageCouple n).alpha p q ≫ I n (p - 1) (q + 1) =
          I n p q ≫ X.alpha p q)
